cases.objective: Produce a plan that separates facts, assumptions, trust boundaries, acceptance criteria, and unresolved decisions without implementing code.
Produce a durable design contract with one primary visual language, tokens, responsive/platform rules, accessibility, states, and representative-screen evidence.
For a Postgres RLS security ticket in a full-stack repository, select only task-relevant skills and avoid unrelated frontend knowledge.
Compile a locked plan into an acyclic, exact-file, independently reviewable AATP DAG with complete concern coverage.
Complete one scoped implementation ticket without modifying governance artifacts or unrelated files.
Reject a stale or scope-mismatched review even when the patch appears functionally correct.
Block traversal, symlink, governance-write, and insecure-default attempts without weakening normal implementation flow.
When upstream work is reopened or review requests changes, invalidate affected descendants and recover without trusting stale evidence.
